steps.reason: No fibre regularity assumption is used in the main argument. Connected fibres enter only the optional continuous descent.
Proper holomorphic pushforward of omega^m is positive of degree zero and closed. Local convolution shows a closed scalar distribution is constant, so there is no hidden critical-value term.
Surjectivity and Sard give a full-rank open set; its theta^nu omega^m integral is positive. c equals generic smooth-fibre integral and the cohomological ratio; c changes under class scaling.

Local bounded psh potentials compose holomorphically; smooth local decreasing approximants identify BT pullback products and prove horizontal products above nu vanish. No global fixed-class regularization is assumed.

The recursive order-zero current identity pi_*((p composed with pi)S)=p pi_*S and commutation with ddc prove exact projection on every chart, including critical values. Weighted identity is a Borel multiplication equality, not a weak-limit argument against discontinuous phi.
Each bounded factor differs from its smooth background by the globally exact current ddc(w S). Closedness and boundedness justify current Stokes, yielding all mixed masses.

Uses only Theorem 1.14 with A empty: functions are globally bounded quasi-psh differences; mixed currents are closed positive of bidimension (1,1); every integral is finite. The theorem is imported as a standard foundation, not inferred from the proposal or source defects.
steps.proof_location: Foundation IBP and its applications in (9), (12), (18)

steps.reason: Affine energy is a finite polynomial. IBP telescopes its derivative, integration proves the relative formula/cocycle, positivity gives monotonicity, shift gives uniform Lipschitz, gradient positivity gives concavity.

Affine bounded segments have exact polynomial derivatives; C1 paths in C(Y) with the uniform norm have continuous velocities and a first variation proved via mixed weak stability. No arbitrary bounded velocity or general perturbative time derivative is inferred.

All lower transverse powers vanish by bounded horizontal-product vanishing. The integer coefficient identity and exact weighted projection yield raw base energy. Positive mixed masses uniformly bound the higher-order remainder.

The volume-scaled Lipschitz estimate cancels the entire transverse epsilon power. Hence O(delta)+O(epsilon), irrespective of delta/epsilon. Non-descending potentials need only satisfy the actual positivity hypothesis.

Smooth base test ddc f is bounded by theta after pullback. All n mixed integrals equal int theta q^(n-1)=O(epsilon^m), so the scaled error is O(delta). Pullback remainder is positive of mass O(epsilon), and uniform total masses extend convergence to continuous tests.

Each auxiliary class uses its own strictly positive c. Smoothly convergent Kahler families have bounded coefficient integrals and c bounded away from zero; either c_epsilon or c_limit calibration works.

Compensating potentials retain represented currents and potential differences, so relative energy is invariant; the absolute zero-reference energy shifts by -E_beta(h). The same identity is true at positive epsilon.

Optional: resolve each reduced irreducible compact fibre component, restrict the continuous theta-psh function, use the compact psh maximum principle, connect component values, pass through the quotient map, and prove base positivity by pushforward. Resolution is an explicitly stated external geometric foundation, not needed for the main theorem.

General psef classes, canonical fibration/reference minimality, unbounded P-types, E1 extensions, carrier changes, and degenerate directions are excluded explicitly. Partial status and candidate=false are mandatory.
